gbm_population_evidence.quote: Effect of Electroacupuncture Combined With Paclitaxel Clinical Efficacy of Patients With Recurrence of High-grade Glioma
Histologically confirmed high-grade glioma, with standard radiotherapy and chemotherapy post-surgical resection deemed unsuccessful, and recurrence confirmed by imaging.

candidate_evidence.quote: Consequently, this study aims to observe the safety and efficacy of SMES combined with ABX in treating patients with recurrent high-grade gliomas postoperatively
ABX was administered intravenously at a dose of 110mg/m2 on days 1 and 8 of a 28-day treatment cycle

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed high-grade glioma, with standard radiotherapy and chemotherapy post-surgical resection deemed unsuccessful, and recurrence confirmed by imaging.

role_evidence.quote: Preliminary research by our team has demonstrated that Specific Mode Electroacupuncture Stimulation (SMES) can open the blood-brain barrier, enhancing the concentration of albumin-bound paclitaxel (ABX) in tumor tissues, peritumoral tissues, and surrounding invasive tissues
TMZ group: Temozolomide（TMZ） was given orally or intravenously 150mg/(m2·d) for 5 days, repeated every 28 days for 6 cycles

coder_notes: Fails S5: recurrent 'high-grade glioma' with no explicit mention of glioblastoma in conditions, title or inclusion criteria. Coded in full anyway. Albumin-bound paclitaxel is the only investigational drug, delivered with specific-mode electroacupuncture stimulation (device) intended to open the BBB -> device_dependent true (R4). formulation_flag left 'none' because albumin-bound paclitaxel is used as an existing licensed product; adjudicator may prefer new_formulation. TMZ is given in both arms (soc_backbone); the OTHER-type 'TMZ group' arm functions as the control. Tumour concentration of ABX is cited from preliminary research only; no tumour PK measurement is planned in this trial.
